summary: No evidence of installer harm in rdfxvela@3.0.2
details: Package rdfxvela@3.0.2 was scanned and no behavioral or pattern-based indicators of supply-chain attack were observed in its shipped contents. No lifecycle hooks fetching or executing external code, no installer-secret reads, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no dropper or backdoor mechanisms, and no shipped third-party credentials were identified.
